place.en: The deeps of Lake Lei · Before the cauldron

setup.zh: 兖鼎从泥里升起来。鼎身上铸着河、泽、桑林和飞鸟——兖州的一切。雷声停了。它在等一个装得下它的人。
setup.en: The Cauldron of Yan rises from the mud. Cast on its body are rivers, marshes, mulberry groves and birds — everything of Yan. The thunder has stopped. It is waiting for someone who can hold it.

label.en: Take the cauldron's breath · Form the Core

exits.means: touches the cauldron, takes its breath, attempts the breakthrough

refuse.zh: 鼎气扑到你身上又退开。筑基未满，装不下。先回人间，把功课做满。
refuse.en: The breath surges over you and draws back. Your Foundation is not yet full enough to hold it. Go back to the world and fill your practice first.

text.zh: 雷从无云的天上落下来，一道接一道，落进丹田。你站住了。丹田里的气拧成一颗丹。鼎小了，小到能握在掌心，和冀鼎并排。
text.en: Thunder falls from a cloudless sky, bolt after bolt, into your dantian. You stay standing. The breath in your dantian twists into a single core. The cauldron shrinks until it sits in your palm, beside the Cauldron of Ji.

text.zh: 结丹了。你手里有两口鼎。
text.en: The Core is formed. You hold two cauldrons now.

exits.means: hesitates, asks what will happen, wants to prepare first

text.zh: 雷停了两千年才响这一回。它不急。
text.en: It waited two thousand years to thunder once. It is not in a hurry.
